measurements.supplier: Resomer R 202, Evonik (PLA); NPs produced in-house

conditions.instrument: Nano ZS Malvern Zeta Sizer (model 1000HSa, UK)

measurements.evidence_quote: To evaluate the stability of the PLA-NPs suspensions, NP size, distributions, and Zeta potential were determined using the dynamic light scattering (DLS) or the electrophoretic light scattering method (ELS) techniques with a Nano ZS Malvern Zeta Sizer (model 1000HSa, UK) at 25˚C.
